title: thymus lanceolatus
intro: Thymus lanceolatus, commonly known as Creeping Thyme, is a low-growing, flowering perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region. This herb is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties that may help soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Thymus lanceolatus include its ability to act as a carminative, expectorant, and antiseptic, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include thymol, carvacrol, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
